pillar_reactions.evidence: 'Do you feel like training and mobility, you see yourself doing that?' — 'Yeah. I'm already doing that.' He engaged with the substance and extended it himself, asking whether meditation and yoga were included and volunteering a long aside on traditional Indian exercise clubs and the mace.

'Do you feel like, did you see yourself sticking to that?' — 'Yeah.' No questions and no resistance, though earlier he had pushed back firmly on the underlying premise: 'I eat butter, I eat beef, and I don't think I want to give it up.' The rep did not test whether the whole-foods-plus-eating-window protocol conflicts with that, so the acceptance is untested.

The pillar he wanted most, and stated in his own metaphor: 'I'm 60% there. I need a 40% push from someone.' Also 'basically need a friend. Need a friend who guides me, takes me along the journey... a mentor as well' and 'if I'm being lazy, he can call me out, that's fine.' The finding worth carrying up: this is the pillar he was most enthusiastic about and it is precisely what the $1,000 tier he bought does not include — the rep said so himself, 'no constant check-ins, no actually pushing you.'

anchors.raw: In fact, this year, just before I got sick, I bought this whole rack... this whole cable cross machine rack... I got kettlebells and adjustable weights as well over there... I have a Smith bar, I have the cable cross and these machines and everything. So it's a comprehensive system.
anchors.note: He had already made his big fitness purchase for the year, in equipment rather than coaching, and it is visible on camera behind him. The offer had to compete with sunk capital he was still feeling good about — 'this was the year I finally said, F it, I'm going to build a whole gym.'

anchors.raw: I know a lot of healthy stuff and this and that. I've read researches. I know a lot. So it's like, knowing a lot, but not actually putting it into practice.
anchors.competitor: His own accumulated knowledge, plus the free kettlebell ecosystem he named — Pavel and Joe Rogan
anchors.note: He believes he already owns the information and is only buying the execution layer, which he quantified as 40%. That is an unusually explicit statement of what he thinks he is paying for, and nobody priced it back to him.

anchors.raw: here doctors are happy to just prescribe you statins, immediately start on statins. They've been asking me to take statins for many years. It's not even needed. It's just an industry over here.
anchors.note: Recorded because it functions as an anchor in his decision: he is choosing training and diet as the alternative to medication, which is a strong motivator for the purchase and simultaneously the most serious risk on the call. The rep leaned into it rather than staying out of it.

unmet_demand.want: Published, transparent pricing so he could compare options before the call
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The tiers are deliberately unpublished. 'And does this website list all the programs? — No... we don't just offer it to everyone.' He said plainly why it mattered: 'knowing all the things upfront allows you to have a better perspective.'

unmet_demand.want: Success measured against his lipid panel — triglycerides and cholesterol
unmet_demand.why_unmet: This was the first thing he named as his own success criterion: 'First of all, I'm going to measure this with my lipid markers.' The programme tracks workouts logged, weight and form. There is no biomarker tracking, no baseline draw and no clinician in the loop, and nobody told him so.

unmet_demand.want: The ability to move down from the Caden tier to the University tier if it did not suit
unmet_demand.why_unmet: Explicitly refused — 'No... the six-month commitment is set.' Downgrades are not available in either direction across the ladder, only upgrades, and only from University to Trevor.

unmet_demand.want: Credit of his $1,000 entry fee toward the $3,000 Caden tier if he upgrades
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The rep first implied it applied, then refused it ('Caden, we don't actually. That's only with Trevor'), then reversed and granted it for a one-month window. What he agreed to buy and what the business will honour may not match.

unmet_demand.want: A live weekly session he could attend at a time that suits him, or multiple slots
unmet_demand.why_unmet: One fixed weekly session, time uncertain even to the rep — 'I think 9.30 your time. I'm not 100% sure.' Recordings only otherwise.
